family: R5-N neutral: stop-loss-only distance matrix CORRECTED FORMULA on frozen v30 isotonic-4 x {1x, dd_guard}
hypothesis: Varying ONLY stop distance (frozen per-branch constant multiplier, causal past-only) may shift the monthly-geometric/DD frontier. R1-B scaled stop+TP together and is done; this probe isolates STOP ONLY with the CORRECTED sign-free formula: new_stop = entry + mult*(orig_stop - entry) for mult in {0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.5}. v21 spec (entry - side*mult*(entry - orig)) was WRONG for shorts (mult=1.0 did not reproduce orig_stop on short rows); v27 fixes it. TPs (take_profit_1/2), holding_bars, entry_limit, and the 94 frozen signals are identical in every branch. Exploratory only.
stop_formula: new_stop = entry_limit + mult*(stop_loss - entry_limit). Side-free: mult=1.0 is bit-identical to orig_stop for BOTH longs and shorts (asserted per-side before running); mult<1 tightens toward entry, mult>1 loosens away from entry, symmetrically for both sides. Frozen constant per branch, applied to the per-signal stop_loss column before the run; TPs/holding/entry untouched.
stop_note: Stop multiple is a frozen constant per branch (causal past-only, no fitting, no per-signal tuning). Same 94 frozen signals in every branch; only the stop_loss column values differ by the branch constant. v21 sign bug documented: old formula entry - side*mult*(entry - orig) maps shorts at mult=1.0 to 2*entry - orig instead of orig.
control: stop100_1x (mult=1.0/1x) must match published isotonic_4 exposure1.0 normal (+122.80% total_return, -20.09% max_drawdown, 65 trades) or STOP
dd_guard_reference: stop100_1x (mult=1.0) control sampled equity (trade exit_time/equity_after) from THIS v27 run, past-only 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed level; each dd_guard branch applies the guard state at its OWN signal times. Shared single reference keeps stop mults comparable. Deviation from v03 (own-book per branch) disclosed.
tp_note: ExecutionConfig.tp1_fraction fixed at 0.5 in all branches (engine default); frozen signals carry tp1_fraction=0.5 untouched. Only stop distance varies.
stop_path_note: Pre-run code inspection: src/agentic_alpha_lab/backtest/engine.py run_backtest stop_fill=_stop_fill(bar,direction,float(signal.stop_loss)) reads per-signal stop_loss with stop_first intrabar policy; src/agentic_alpha_lab/backtest/execution_stress.py run_stress stop=_stop_fill(bar,side,float(signal.stop_loss)) reads per-signal stop_loss. Runtime re-asserted in driver.
